incidents.name: BNB48 private-tx MEV bot pancakeCall access control
incidents.notes: The MEV bot's pancakeCall() callback never checked that msg.sender was a genuine PancakeSwap pair, so anyone could invoke it with crafted token0()/token1() and calldata and transfer the bot's whole balance out.

sources.ref: onchain review: bot 0x64dD59D6C7f09dc05B472ce5CB961b6E10106E1d created 2022-08-30T07:16:40Z by 0x7c58b98bc9860778f0b1e72f945b8ff6fd22e48c, unrelated to attack sender 0xee286554f8b315f0560a15b6f085ddad616d0601; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: the exploit transaction moved 25,912.95 USDT, 22,307.55 BUSD, 5,160.33 USDC, 327.93 WBNB, 0.015 BTCB and 0.0975 ETH out of the bot; 327.93 WBNB x $285.39, 0.015 BTCB x $21,396.15 and 0.0975 ETH x $1,636.59 at incidentTimestamp 1663074440 (DefiLlama) give a total of $147,449, close to the ~$140k reported.
